article.title: -ся pasivo
article.chapter: Verbos en -ся: reflexividad, medio y pasiva — Глаголы на -ся

claims.summary: Introduces the passive voice in Russian using the suffix -ся, explaining that the entity receiving the action is presented as the subject, while the doer is in the background or can be omitted.
Compares active and passive voice structures in Russian, illustrating how the subject and object switch roles, and how the agent can be expressed in the instrumental case or omitted.
Provides examples of the passive voice construction in Russian, demonstrating the use of the instrumental case for the agent and the omission of the agent when it is not relevant.

links.notes: The Wikipedia page on the instrumental case provides a clear explanation of the passive voice construction in Russian, specifically mentioning the use of -ся and the placement of the patient as the grammatical subject.
The Wikipedia page provides a detailed comparison between active and passive voice structures, highlighting the instrumental case usage for the agent and the omission of the agent when appropriate.

The Wikipedia page includes practical examples of the passive voice construction, such as 'Документы проверяются комиссией' (The documents are reviewed by the commission) and 'Заявки рассматриваются ежедневно' (The applications are examined daily), illustrating the concepts discussed in the article.
